name: save
description: Save the app to its own git repository, and share it: a repository of its own on GitHub, created and pushed only after a person confirms the plan. Refuses a file that holds a secret, and a private app going to a public remote.
mount: add the scripts "save": "node plugins/save/cli.ts" and "share": "node plugins/save/share-cli.ts" to package.json; mount the plugin to give the agent a save_app tool
